name: BidProof
install:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
uv sync
npm ci --prefix frontend

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: BidProof FastAPI dev server. Public product page at http://localhost:8000/ and the authenticated workbench at http://localhost:8000/app. Uses the local SQLite database by default; personal signup and the trial join code are enabled for development.
